app.R2l0bGFi.desc.source: The GitLab integration provides comprehensive access to GitLab's API for managing your development workflow. Automate repository operations, track issues and merge requests, manage team members and access controls, configure CI/CD variables, and maintain project documentation through wikis. Whether you're coordinating a development team or automating DevOps processes, this integration streamlines your GitLab operations.
